The payout promise: within-a-day wording without processing detail.
The broker relationship: which partner desk executes orders.
The asset list: how many pairs are actually offered.
The registration flow: what personal details the form collects.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Register with your name, email and phone number, and confirm via the email you are sent.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Fund the account with US$200 - bank cards, transfer, PayPal and Skrill are accepted.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Choose your risk level and trading mode, then use the demo to learn the dashboard.

pros: Risk settings before the first trade.
A browser dashboard - nothing to install.
cons: Marketing numbers that the fine print walks back.
No independent audit of the models.
Broker relationship described vaguely.
Registration details not stated up front.
redFlags: Ownership details missing from the public pages.
The demo promised in the pitch but buried in the flow.
A score and a community mood wearing the same number.

faqs.a: The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.
The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.
8 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

bottomLine: Crypto Wealthy reads as a functioning AI trading service with the standard package, and the product itself clears the bar for a cautious trial.

The score reflects the page: claims without verification, figures that conflict and restriction lists that disagree. Use the demo, deposit the minimum, and keep your own numbers - the page cannot be trusted with its own.
